sections.content:
Crucially, the exact same `-lak/-lek` suffix is also used when 'I' address several people at once (**titeket** = you all):
- *Gyerekek, látlak titeket!* = Children, I see you (all)!
- *Nagyon szeretlek titeket!* = I love you all very much!
- *Holnap reggel hívlak titeket.* = Tomorrow morning I will call you all.

items.english: My friends, I am waiting for you all at the restaurant!
I support you all in everything.
